coverage_notes: The model uses direct biological vocabulary expansion and embedding-matrix initialization; the paper does not describe a separate biological encoder or connector. No qualifying biology-dependence test is reported. The ESM-2 result is an external between-system representation comparison. The remote-homology output parser is not specified separately from the standard-homology parser. The paper mentions abandoned synthetic-CoT templates but identifies no language-model generator or generation settings.
